title: [correctness] deliver_via_relay sends DATA with empty rcpt_to — RFC 5321 violation
description: In relay_client.rs, deliver_via_relay() loops over rcpt_to to send RCPT TO commands, then unconditionally proceeds to DATA. If rcpt_to is empty, DATA is sent with zero recipients, violating RFC 5321 §3.3. The peer will respond with 503 (bad sequence) or 501. Fix: validate rcpt_to.is_empty() at start of deliver_via_relay() and return SmtpRelayError::Permanent('no recipients').
